thread: Jordan Lee: dropping a micro-iteration for the autoscale row in narrow breakpoints. Q: best place for the burst hint and how to show pool priority without pushing the pool picker off-screen? screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/compact-v4.png Priya Nair: Inline pill next to the burst switch is my vote. Make it keyboard-focusable and keep copy short: 'Burst — temporary capacity'. Marcus H.: If it's focusable, ensure DOM order puts the pill before the pool picker so tab order is logical. Also add aria-describedby on the switch pointing to the pill id, e.g., aria-describedby="burst-help-2". Elena V.: For visual treatment of priority pools, ditch the filled gold star. Use a small outlined badge + an sr-only label: ★Priority pool. Contrast is better and screen readers get context. Jordan Lee: Good—I'll update the mock. Microcopy thought: change 'Latency SLO' to 'Latency target (95th)'. People keep asking what percentile we're talking about. Priya Nair: +1. Add a tiny hint 'lower is better' under the label. Put hint in DOM for SRs too. Marcus H.: Steppers: bump hit targets to 44px and add aria-labels: aria-label="increase min" / aria-label="decrease max". Also support shift+click for x5 increments. Elena V.: When burst actually triggers, ensure the banner is announced: role="status" aria-live="polite">Burst active: +1 GPU (best-effort). And make the banner dismissible via keyboard. @a11y-bot: checklist: pill contrast >= 4.5:1, focus outline visible, aria-describedby on burst switch, steppers use role="spinbutton" and expose aria-valuemin/max, ephemeral banners use role="status" aria-live="polite". Jordan Lee: Action items: 1) move pill inline and put before pool picker (Jordan). 2) Add aria-describedby to burst switch (Marcus). 3) Swap priority star for outlined + sr-only (Elena). 4) Update label to 'Latency target (95th)' and add hint (Priya). 5) Increase tappable area and add aria-labels for steppers (Marcus). 6) A11y bot run on PR (a11y-bot). Priya Nair: I'll land the copy patches today. Marcus H.: I'll handle DOM reorder and aria attributes, and add the spinbutton attrs. Elena V.: I'll tweak the badge and the burst banner behavior. Jordan Lee: Thanks team 44d aiming for a follow-up mock tomorrow morning.
